params.q: Which coaching institute did Simrandeep Kaur, UPSC CSE 2025 AIR 15, study at?

response.reconstructed_markdown:
Simrandeep Kaur was associated with [Vision IAS](https://visionias.in/blog/english/simrandeep-kaur-air-15-upsc-2025-background-upsc-journey-marksheet-toppers-copy) during her UPSC preparation. [0]

Rather than a full\-time general classroom program, she utilized their targeted test series and evaluation programs, which included:

- All India GS Mains Test Series
- Abhyaas Prelims and Abhyaas Mains
- Abhyaas Essay and Abhyaas PSIR Optional
- Personality Development Program \(Interview guidance\) [0]

Would you like to know more about her optional subject strategy \(PSIR\) or her preparation timeline across her attempts?
